response.sql: WITH per_scan AS (SELECT crewref, gbsize / spanmin AS r FROM scans WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0), op AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(r) AS avg_gbpm FROM per_scan GROUP BY crewref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gbpm) AS g FROM op) SELECT AVG(op.n) AS avg_scan_count, AVG(op.avg_gbpm) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(op.avg_gbpm - overall.g) AS avg_margin FROM op, overall WHERE op.avg_gbpm > overall.g
